metadata.hardware_requirements: The Q-network is trained in 106 training frames, and each scenario is evaluated in 20 simulation experiments. The training process... can be finished in less than 24 hours on a computing server with NVIDIA Quadro K620 GPU and Intel Xeon CPU E5-1650 (3.6 GHz, 6 cores).

nodes_process.node_name: Extract Vehicle Locations and Form Position Matrix
nodes_process.source_quote: Vehicle locations are extracted from the traffic video frames and are reformed as position matrices.
nodes_process.description: Extract (x,y) coordinates of vehicles from raw video frames and create a position matrix m_t where a constant Uv represents a vehicle and 0 otherwise. The matrix additionally contains signal state information (UG/UR for green/red). Down-sampling is introduced before matrix stack to reduce input dimensions.

nodes_process.node_name: Stack Position Matrices for Traffic State
nodes_process.source_quote: we stack the matrices of consecutive N time steps to represent the state s_t:
nodes_process.description: Stack N consecutive (down-sampled) position matrices (m_t-(N-1) through m_t) to form the traffic state s_t for the deep reinforcement learning model.

nodes_process.source_quote: The reward r_t after action a_t is defined by the following: r_t = micro*v_t + omega*q_t, micro > 0, omega < 0,
nodes_process.description: Define the reward function r_t as a weighted sum of average speed (v_t) in the merging area and average queue length (q_t) at the on-ramp, using positive speed weight (micro) and negative queue length weight (omega).

nodes_process.source_quote: We adopt a deep neural network termed Q-network to approximate Q*(s, a). The neural network contains several convolutional layers and fully connected layers.
nodes_process.description: Design a Deep Q-network (DQN) architecture by modifying the Q-network from Mnih et al. [30]. The network comprises three convolutional neural network (CNN) layers and one full connection (FC) layer per output layer, extended to two FC layers for multitask learning (Q-value, speed, queue length). Relu activations are used.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=3, 2/3 tools named, all params stated

nodes_process.source_quote: The gradient-based algorithm Adam [28] is used to update w_i to minimize the loss function.
nodes_process.description: Train the Q-network using deep Q-learning with experience replay and a target network to stabilize learning. Employ a multitask learning strategy for simultaneous prediction of Q-value, mean speed, and queue length. The Adam optimizer is used, with an e-greedy strategy for action selection.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=4, 3/6 tools named, 9/10 params stated (gamma missing)

nodes_process.source_quote: The proposed method is evaluated in SUMO, an open-source microscopic traffic simulator [31].
nodes_process.description: Set up a microscopic traffic simulation environment using SUMO, modeling a freeway connecting Qingdao and Huangdao through a tunnel. Calibrate driving behavior parameters based on empirical data. Define speed limits for mainline and on-ramp, and configure simulation time and traffic volumes.

nodes_process.source_quote: the second scenario adopts the PI-ALINEA method. The PI-ALINEA method fixes the length of the green phase and determines the length of the red phase...
nodes_process.description: Implement the PI-ALINEA ramp metering method as a baseline. The algorithm calculates the ramp metering rate r_k based on current and previous downstream occupancies, aiming for a desired mainline occupancy. Green phase length is fixed to the decision step size L.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=4, 1/2 tools named, all params stated

nodes_process.source_quote: each scenario is evaluated in 20 simulation experiments.
nodes_process.description: Conduct 20 simulation experiments for each of the three scenarios: the proposed DRL method, PI-ALINEA method, and no-control. Each simulation is initialized with different random seeds. Performance metrics such as travel times, queue lengths, and traffic flows are recorded.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=4, 1/2 tools named, all params stated

nodes_process.source_quote: Figure 9 presents the Q1 (25%), Q2 (50%), and Q3 (75%) of the travel times in the mainline for three scenarios.
nodes_process.description: Process and analyze the raw simulation results to generate comparative figures and tables. These include mean travel times, queue lengths, traffic flows, temporal-spatial distribution of speeds, and relationships between queue length and occupancy for the DRL, PI-ALINEA, and no-control scenarios.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=4, no tools named, no params stated
